org.name: Mellon
org.shortDescription: Mellon is a design agency that builds brand identities, digital products, and design systems for teams across architecture, automotive, technology, finance, and more.

footer.tagline: A design agency for teams who need brand, product, and interface design to work as one system.

hero.headline: Design that carries a brand from first impression to daily use.
hero.subhead: We build identity systems, digital products, and design systems for teams who need brand and product to move as one — across architecture, automotive, technology, finance, and a dozen industries besides.

servicesIntro.headline: Ten disciplines. One studio.
servicesIntro.body: From a first brand mark to a fully governed design system, Mellon covers the full range of design work a growing company needs — without the hand-offs between agencies.

industriesIntro.headline: Deep enough in each industry to skip the learning curve.
industriesIntro.body: We've designed for architecture firms and automotive teams, fintechs and restaurant groups. Each industry page below reflects what we've actually learned building for it.

process.headline: Design and development, under one roof.
process.body: Mellon runs as two connected consulting practices — design and development — so the systems we design are the systems that ship, not a set of files thrown over a wall.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: Strategy, brand, UX, and UI — built in Figma and tested before a single line of code.

steps.title: Development
steps.body: Implementation in Webflow, Framer, WordPress, or custom code, by a team that already knows the design intent.

closingCta.headline: Tell us what you're building.
closingCta.body: Every engagement starts with a conversation, not a proposal template. Tell us where things stand and we'll tell you honestly whether — and how — we can help.

hero.headline: A design studio built to run design and development as one practice.
hero.subhead: Mellon exists because brand, product, and engineering usually get designed in separate rooms — and it shows. We keep them in one room.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Mellon is a design agency working across branding, product design, and design systems. We're a small, senior studio by design: every engagement is run by people who've done the specific kind of work you're hiring for, not handed to whoever's free.

sections.heading: What we do
sections.body: Ten core disciplines — branding, design systems, e-commerce design, end-to-end design, mobile app design, motion and interaction design, product design, SaaS design, UI/UX design, and UX audits — delivered individually or combined into a single end-to-end engagement.

sections.heading: How we work
sections.body: Every project runs through the same two practices: design and development. Design covers strategy, brand, UX, and UI. Development covers implementation, in Webflow, Framer, WordPress, or custom code — by people who were in the room for the design decisions, so nothing gets lost in a handoff.

sections.heading: Who we work with
sections.body: Sixteen industries and counting: architecture and interior design, automotive, civic tech, consumer electronics, e-commerce, education, fashion, finance, health and wellness, hospitality, legal, media and entertainment, nonprofits, real estate, restaurants, and technology and SaaS. Each industry page reflects patterns we've seen working in that space specifically, not a generic template.

sections.heading: Where we start
sections.body: With a conversation, not a proposal template. Tell us what you're building, and we'll tell you plainly whether we're the right studio for it.

hero.headline: Start a project.
hero.subhead: Tell us about what you're building and where things stand today. We reply to every inquiry personally, usually within one business day.
